job.qpu_charge_time_provenance: IBM Runtime job metrics retrieved for the completed job; the pre-closure local job_manifest records completion but not charge time

interpretation: In this frozen 20-circuit four-qubit validation workload on ibm_pittsburgh, the ideal simulator and physical QPU produced similar output distributions relative to the much larger discrepancy between the current CC-NQE/QuTE model and the ideal simulator. The dominant observed error source is therefore the learned model approximation, not hardware noise, within this limited experiment.
r1_implication: QPU Validation v1 provides empirical motivation for R1 because Composition-OOD model error greatly exceeded Sim-QPU discrepancy. It does not demonstrate an R1 solution or change the R1 protocol.
